diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on the 'ordinary testing room' without text-to-speech for written directions and no language aid, which aligns with the 'testing_environment' and 'text_to_speech_for_written_directions' decisions in PF1. Since PF1 is the only decisive fact related to the testing environment and language support, and it was never revealed in any of the rollouts, the model defaulted to these common settings, thus passing checks C1 and C2 without needing the hidden information.
